Live free in the Sun! An elegant and modern solution for showing the Sunrise, Sunset, First and Last Light times to the exact minute for precisely where YOU are right now - not the "closest" city. The app also shows exactly how much daylight is left in the day - in a large, easy to read display - so you can plan ahead to the last ray of sunlight. Download it now.

It shows: 
• Sunrise time 
• Sunset time 
• First Light time (Dawn) 
• Last Light time (Twilight)
• Converts timezones for foreign locations
• Counts down the amount of daylight left in the day until last light 
• At night, counts down the time left until the first light of the new day 
• Counts down days, hours and minutes left until the shortest and longest days 
• Dates of the equinox and solstice 
• Times of the equinox and solstice for premium users
• See the Sunrise, Sunset, First and Last light times for any day in the future. 
• Length of daylight for today - or any day in the future.
• Percentage of the day or night completed.
• Correctly handles Daylight Saving times. 
• GPS access is not required.
• Landscape support on iPad.

An indispensable tool for those who don't want to waste a moment of the day - or the night!
